title: Hello, I'm <1>Alejandro</1>
intro: I am a web developer and computer engineering student. I am proficient in technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Java, and modern frameworks, with experience in practical projects and technical support. I am characterized by my initiative, autonomy, and commitment to quality in every development project. I enjoy learning new technologies and applying them to real projects, always seeking to improve my skills and grow professionally.
